info.name: Execute a FieldAgent GraphQL query via GET

params.name: variables
params.description: URL-encoded JSON object of GraphQL variables.

items.docs: GraphQL queries may also be issued as a GET request with the `query` (and optional `variables`) passed as query-string parameters. Requires the same Bearer auth_token.

info.name: Execute a FieldAgent GraphQL query or mutation

items.docs: Single GraphQL endpoint for all FieldAgent operations. Send a GraphQL query or mutation in the request body. Requires a Sentera auth_token supplied as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Returns a standard GraphQL response envelope with `data` and/or `errors`.
